description_sq: Shitet toke per ndertim kapanonesh Vaqarr te Keshtjella Konti , toka ka gjeresi 48m dhe gjatesi 77m pershkohet nga te dy krahet nga rruga kryesore qe lidh rrugen Vaqarrin me Arbanen dhe Teg-un.Toka ka dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor, ne njolle lejla ,zone industriale,lartesi deri ne 11 m .
description_en: Land for sale for the construction of silos Vaqarr in Keshtjella Konti, the land is 48m wide and 77m long, it is crossed from both sides by the main road that connects Vaqarr with Arbanen and Teg. The land has regular mortgage documentation, in purple spots, industrial zone, height up to 11 m.
